name: sheet
description: The form of a screen: one rectangle, hairline-ruled into rows, one per screen. Its children are the record's rows (written, recorded, the note, the day, the mood), section heads, settings rows, or the auth content; every child after the first is ruled off above.

form.description: account is the account sheet of the signed-out and account screens (was .auth-sheet): on the auth spread its two-column grid and unruled sections; its content column (form) is 440, centred.

tag.description: main where the sheet is the screen's main content; div where it sits inside another region (the auth spread, the guide).

children.description: The rows, one after another; the sheet rules them off.

places.span: a state message: the full grid, the sheet's padding
places.form: the account content: a 440 column, centred (the full column in the website preview at tablet and desktop)
places.copy: the explanatory copy: --s6 above what follows

states.hover: n/a: the sheet is not a control; its rows carry their own
states.focus-visible: n/a: not focusable; its rows' controls carry the ring
states.loading: n/a: a loading state is a state message among its rows
states.error: n/a: an error is a state message among its rows
states.empty: n/a: an empty day shows the empty line inside it, not an empty sheet

a11y.labels: its section heads name its parts

responsive.700: the auth spread's sides stack (legacy context .auth-paper)
responsive.1200: on a split page, a row reached from the index lands inset by the page's gutter (legacy context .page.split)

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css C1 (.sheet, its row rules, and the auth spread's and pinned header's contexts).
Carries the auth spread's two-column grid and its 700px stacking (legacy context .auth-paper), moved from lock.css with the auth section.
